summary: Iter 56 verified the GEID one-record-per-user workflow end-to-end: two-tier hard-delete (sub-admin request + main-admin approve/decline), test-account flagging with auto-flag for automation emails, one-click complete-record export, and full regression on the 7 real users. Backend pytest 8/8 PASS in ~48s (/app/backend/tests/test_iter56_hard_delete_flow.py). Frontend UI verified against main-admin session on /admin-cms Users tab: 7 real customer_ids surfaced (00001,00002,00003,00004,00009,00010,00011); expanding a row renders Personal / Company / Documents & Status columns, 'Shared profile (full record)' block, and the full action bar (Edit profile, Contact, Payment details, Documents, Download record, Mark as test account, Hard delete). Main-admin sees 'Hard delete' label (not 'Request hard delete') per role. Vaibhav 00002 row carries name, mobile 7020691832, company 'Vametra.com' and email vaibhav.deshmane@vametra.com — regression from iter55 holds.
action_items: None blocking. All Phase-D (GEID / hard-delete / test-flag / export) endpoints and their RBAC gates work correctly; sub-admin cannot bypass to /hard-delete or /delete-requests; main admin lists + declines requests as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_ops.hard_delete purges 12 collections + DO registry + Firebase but the response reports identity.do_registry='skipped' whenever DO_BASE or the caller's Authorization header is missing. If a main admin's Firebase token expires mid-session and the SPA silently re-issues via a stale sessionStorage token, the DO registry write could be skipped without any UI banner — worth surfacing an explicit warning to the admin when do_registry != 'deleted'.

admin_ops.hard_delete purges data BEFORE the DO/Firebase deletion. If the DO call fails (e.g. network blip), the website state is already gone but the identity/sign-in survives — the user could still authenticate but land on an empty account. Consider making DO deletion atomic-first, or retrying and rolling back the archive if identity deletion fails.
TEST_EMAIL_HINTS in subadmin._looks_like_test hardcodes automation prefixes; a data-owner override list would be nicer than editing source when the pattern changes.

DeleteQueue.jsx re-fetches /admin/delete-requests on every UsersManager render — a small useEffect optimisation (poll on interval + refresh after decline) would avoid the extra call when no requests are pending.
admin_ops export_user runs 5+ Mongo queries + 1 blocking DO GET per call — fine at 12 users but should be measured before scaling; consider a $facet aggregation for the archive/export path.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — expanded row + action bar + labels correct; delete-queue mounts only when pending requests exist (empty queue after decline, as expected)
